title: phagnalon saxatile
intro: Phagnalon saxatile, commonly known as Rock Phagnalon or Rock Cudweed, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phagnalon saxatile include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
